top_signals.title: Gulf Arab Oil Giants Are Exporting Crude at Pre-War Rates Again
top_signals.summary: The Middle East’s leading Arab oil producing nations are shipping crude at about the same rate as before the war, bringing a tide of supply to the global market that’s helped to temper prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
